items.headline: GMC survey finds many locally employed and SAS doctors face bullying but fear speaking up
items.summary: A survey of more than 10,500 doctors found 23% of locally employed and 31% of SAS doctors had experienced or witnessed bullying or harassment. Most who did not report felt it would make no difference.

items.headline: Using AI-assisted moderation to expand virtual reality healthcare simulation capacity
items.summary: An article argues AI can reduce facilitator workload in VR simulation, freeing educators to focus on learner performance and debriefing, while keeping faculty in control and piloting on a small scale.

items.headline: Which? calls for a private dentistry ombudsman as ONS data shows high patient satisfaction
items.summary: Which? surveyed people who had already had a problem with private dental care and called for an independent ombudsman. The BDA says that sample is not representative; ONS data shows 93.5% of private and 89.9% of NHS patients satisfied.
